title: vec![addr.clone()] in parse_email_addrs: use iter::once
description: In parse_email_addrs, MailAddr::Single arm does vec![info.addr.clone()] which allocates a Vec<String> just to flat_map over it. Idiomatic Rust: std::iter::once(info.addr.clone()) avoids the heap allocation. Similarly Group arm could use addrs.iter().map(|i| i.addr.clone()) without collect then re-iterate — it already does this. Only the Single arm needs fixing.
